reader.requirement: An OPEN in any mode (including the 85-only REVERSED phrase) neither reads a record into the record area nor writes the record area to the file, on every organization: the first READ after it gets the first (or, REVERSED, the last) record, an OUTPUT/EXTEND OPEN then CLOSE adds no record, and an I-O OPEN establishes no record for REWRITE.

edition-consulted.switches: REVERSED phrase admitted at 85, refused COBOL0902 from 2002; the runtime effect FileRegistry#ReversedPhraseEffect runs only at 85

reader.edition-search: grep Edition|DialectBehavior in SequentialConnector#OpenCore and KeyedConnector#OpenCore: none; the only edition arm is the REVERSED phrase gate (ConstructRegistry open-reversed-removed-2002) whose effect runs only at 85
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: only 85 has OPEN ... REVERSED, which positions at the end without reading
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witness covers sequential INPUT, OUTPUT and EXTEND; not exercised: REVERSED, I-O (REWRITE after OPEN), relative and indexed files, OUTPUT with a filled record area

probes.expected: VII.4.3.4 GR11c/GR12: REVERSED positions at the end; the OPEN obtains nothing, so the first READ gives the last record
OPEN I-O obtains no record, so a REWRITE before any READ is 43 (VII.1.3.5 4c) and the file is unchanged
relative/indexed: OPEN OUTPUT with a filled record area releases nothing (first READ at end, 10); OPEN INPUT/I-O obtains nothing (first READ gives the first record)

citations.check: OK  §1985:VII.4.3.4 GR6  (4.3.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR6

reader.notes: The OPEN bodies only reset position state and open handles; no record transfer is emitted by EmitOpen. Probed on all three organizations and with the 85-only REVERSED phrase. Aside (not this rule): OPEN INPUT F SHARING WITH NO OTHER at --std 85 is refused, but with COBOL2073 naming a WHEN OTHER phrase, because SHARING is a user word at 85.

refuter.evidence: Read §1985:VII.4.3.4 GR6 (cite.py OK). The reader left the sequential OUTPUT and EXTEND opens with a filled record area untested, as well as the optional-create path and a LINAGE file. r6_seq.cob printed OUT-EMPTY=10 (OPEN OUTPUT then CLOSE with the record area holding FULL/FUL2 released nothing). After OPEN EXTEND and CLOSE with the record area holding XTND, it printed REC=R001 and AFTER-EXTEND-COUNT=01, so nothing was appended. An optional absent file opened EXTEND gave OP-EXTEND-CREATE=05 and then OP-EMPTY=10. A LINAGE file's OPEN OUTPUT and CLOSE left a 0-byte file with LC=1, so the OPEN wrote no record and no page advance. Together with the reader's REVERSED, I-O and keyed probes, this leaves no form of OPEN that obtains or releases a record.
